g.title: CTCL_QSP
g.text: Cutaneous T-Cell Lymphoma (Mycosis Fungoides / Sézary Syndrome) — QSP Mechanistic Map
one clone, three compartments, two host variables

g.title: cluster_genome
g.text: 2. Genomic Lesions (Choi 2015 / da Silva Almeida 2015 / Wang 2015)

g.title: cluster_skin
g.text: 5. SKIN — the T_RM box; mSWAT reads only this box

g.title: cluster_blood
g.text: 6. BLOOD — the T_CM box; B-score reads only this box

g.title: cluster_surv
g.text: 9. Anti-tumour Surveillance — the SECOND independent state variable

g.title: cluster_itch
g.text: 11. Pruritus Circuit — decouples from tumour burden

g.title: cluster_sdt
g.text: 14. Skin-Directed Therapy — reaches the SKIN box only

g.title: cluster_immuno
g.text: 15. Immunomodulators — the drugs that move the SURVEILLANCE variable

g.title: S1PR1
g.text: (the only exit out of the tissue)

g.title: ERYTH
g.text: the component arising from the blood clone

g.title: GLOBAL
g.text: = the logical AND over every involved compartment

g.title: MARash
g.text: a direct consequence of Treg depletion (~24–32%)

g.title: IMMSK
g.text: IMM_SK — immune killing rate in skin

g.title: IMMBL
g.text: IMM_BL — immune killing rate in blood

g.title: ATOX
g.text: α-toxin → death of CD8 and non-malignant T cells

g.title: INFEC
g.text: the leading cause of death in CTCL

g.title: SENS
g.text: SENS — central sensitisation (a slow state variable)

g.title: ORRg
g.text: = the logical AND of the compartment ORRs

g.title: OSe
g.text: (by stage: IB ~normal · IIB 4.7 y · IVA1 3.8 y · IVB 1.4 y)

g.title: TSEBd->E8SK
g.text: burns out the skin CD8 T_RM as well

g.title: ECPd->NBLs
g.text: in proportion to the blood volume treated

g.title: GVHD
g.text: Graft-versus-host disease (especially after pre-transplant MOGA exposure)

g.title: MOGC
g.text: MOG1/MOG2 — antibody central and peripheral compartments

g.title: MOGC->JHOME
g.text: (it blocks the road, not the cells)

g.title: OCCsk->NSKs
g.text: skin ADCC — occupancy is ample but
there are no effector cells, so it is 8-fold weaker

g.title: ALEMpk->E8SK
g.text: removes CD8 and NK cells too

g.title: RESK
g.text: residual drug effect in the resistant subclone

g.title: MARash->E8SK
g.text: the other face of Treg depletion —
the rash and the response travel together
